key_idea: Count small triangles, then triangles made of 2 pieces, then the big one.
steps: The big triangle is cut into 3 small triangles: green, orange and pink. That is 3.
Two pieces next to each other also make a triangle: green with orange, and orange with pink. That is 2 more.
All 3 pieces together make the big triangle. That is 1 more.

choice_feedback.A: 4 counts the 3 small triangles and the big one, but misses the 2 made of two pieces.
choice_feedback.B: 5 misses one triangle. Check the ones made of 2 pieces and the big one.
choice_feedback.C: 7 is too many. Green and pink do not touch, so they do not make a triangle together.
choice_feedback.D: 8 is too many. Only 6 triangles can be found.
